text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

1. Reps got back about 5 hours a week. CRM updates went from end-of-day chores to a quick review.

2. Follow-ups got faster. Emails went out within an hour of the meeting, not the next morning.

3. Managers coached from real conversations instead of rep summaries. That changed 1:1s more than we expected.

4. Not every customer was comfortable. Asking consent upfront mattered, and a few said no.

5. Accuracy slipped on product names and noisy sites. Human review still matters.

The biggest lesson: the tool didn't make reps better sellers. It gave them time to be better sellers.

What did your team learn from your pilot?
